description: This file contains implementation of OpenGL ES 2.0 API entry points, including function wrappers, platform-specific assembly routines for different architectures, and functions that wrap OpenGL string and parameter queries. It also includes license information and external dependencies related to Android's graphics and logging.

methods.name: glGetString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the GL connection, delegating to platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: glGetStringi
methods.description: Returns a string from the indexed list of GL extensions, delegating to platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: glGetBooleanv
methods.description: Retrieves boolean state variables from the GL context, delegating to platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: glGetFloatv
methods.description: Retrieves float state variables from the GL context, delegating to platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: glGetIntegerv
methods.description: Retrieves integer state variables from the GL context, delegating to platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: glGetInteger64v
methods.description: Retrieves 64-bit integer state variables from the GL context, delegating to platform-specific implementation.
